_comment: Hook registration for the harness comms lifecycle. ARC-8 collapsed the comms model onto uniform singular inboxes, so the per-generation SessionStart/SessionEnd registry lifecycle is gone -- only UserPromptSubmit (role recovery + unread notice) and Stop (continue-on-unread) remain. Paths are PORTABLE -- they resolve against $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (the clone's own root), so this ships to other machines unchanged. INTERPRETER: the commands use 'python', the canonical launcher on the Windows substrate this harness targets (verified to resolve there). On a clone where the Python launcher is named 'python3' instead (some Linux/macOS shells have no bare 'python'), substitute 'python' -> 'python3' in both commands below -- a one-line per-machine edit. Likewise if your Claude Code version does not expand $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in a hook command, replace it with the absolute path to THIS clone's .claude/hooks dir. See docs/charc-bootstrap.md.
_comment_usage: Standing permission rule (owner, 2026-10-27): the orchestrator and director sessions may run scripts/usage_claude.py, which reads the Claude Code OAuth token once to fetch this account's weekly usage window for the dual-model dispatch tiebreak (docs/proofs/harness-dual-model-implementers.md). No other credential access is granted.
